_comment: Single source for banned wording. Read by BOTH acceptance layers: scripts/acceptance.py (server HTML) and scripts/hydrated-acceptance.mjs (after hydration). Kept in one file because two copies of a rule set is the exact drift this property has now been bitten by three times -- comparison specs, icon extensions, and field-guide contents. Patterns are written to be valid in both Python re and JS RegExp.

patterns.app usability claim: FREE APP|in PrintLog3D|check the app|Download the app

_case_sensitive_comment: Rules listed in case_sensitive are matched exactly. Everything else is matched case-insensitively. Both matter and the default is wrong for both halves: FREE APP matched case-sensitively missed 'Get the Free App' on six pages for months, and NaN matched case-INsensitively fires on the 'nan' inside 'maintenance'. NaN and the placeholder token are literal program values that only ever appear in one casing.
